one_month_reasoning: Inside the window to 2026-12-20: Q3 FY27 results and the Q4 guide on Dec 1 (call 1:30pm PT, source 15). Q3 revenue is already pre-announced at the $3.15B midpoint (+/-2%, source 9), so the print itself carries little surprise; the Q4 guide vs consensus $3.73B / $1.36 (source 16) and any FY28 update after the Lumentum announcement are the swing. Our build gives Q4 ~$3.73B, so no edge on direction. Also in the window: NVIDIA's leadership transition after the Nov 16 chip selloff (source 19), S-4 / merger filings, and Broadcom's results (mid-December). The stock has fallen ~56% from the early-October high (sources 20), which leaves room for a reversal bounce but also for momentum; we centre at $123.5 (a slight reversal tilt, +1%) with a 23% one-month log sd (realized vol 86%/3.5 = 24.6%, trimmed slightly because Q3 revenue is already known).

fair_value.method: Quarterly driver build (customer AI capex x MRVL capture; comms; non-GAAP GM and opex) to FY2029, valued at the horizon on NTM non-GAAP EPS ~$8.90 x 19.2x (60%) and NTM levered FCF ~$7.87/share at a 4.5% yield (40%), less a probability-weighted Lumentum merger transfer (-$5.4B incl. the regulatory fee risk) = $166.66 research target (12m).

downside.story: AI capex digestion: customer capex lands near the low case (CY2027 ~1.4T, CY2028 flat-to-down), MRVL loses a custom socket to Broadcom/MediaTek and custom mix compresses GM; P/E falls toward NVDA/CRDO levels (~15x) while the Lumentum overhang persists.

base.story: Customer AI capex on the standing base case (CY2027 1.84T, CY2028 2.26T); MRVL capture rises from 0.75% to ~0.97% of it as custom (a key hyperscaler, Google TPU attach) and scale-up optics ramp; FY2028 revenue $19.2B (consensus $19.7B, outlook ~$20B), FY2028 non-GAAP EPS ~$7.28 (consensus $7.33); the stock re-rates from 18x toward 19x NTM as the AI selloff and merger overhang ease, with a ~$6/share deal drag.

upside.story: Capex follows the high case (CY2027 ~2.4T), Google TPU attach and the key hyperscaler XPU ramp put FY2028 at or above the ~$20B outlook, scale-up optics adds; the sector re-rates to the snapshot peer median and the deal is seen as accretive.

sbc_treatment.note: SBC FY2026 $590.8M (F36), TTM $828.9M (F39), Q2 FY27 $326.2M. EBIT is non-GAAP (ex SBC), consistent with peers' non-GAAP consensus P/E; SBC enters as share issuance (~1.2% a year) net of ~$800M a year buybacks paid in cash (shareholder_returns), so diluted shares grow +0.5% a year.

reasoning: MRVL fell from ~$275 (early October, after an Investor Day that set FY2028 ~ $20B and FY2031 $70-90B) to $122 on three things: the Nov 2 all-stock $115B Lumentum deal (4.5 MRVL per LITE, MRVL holders keep ~67%, close H1 CY2028, after our horizon), the Nov 16 chip selloff after NVIDIA's CEO left, and general AI-capex nerves. Fundamentals from the filings are intact: Q2 FY27 revenue $2,739M (+37%), DC $2,171.5M (+46%), Q3 pre-announced at the $3.15B midpoint, Google custom agreement with a warrant (Aug 19), and a five-quarter record of beating the revenue midpoint by 0.3-1.5%. Build: DC = customer AI capex (standing file base, CY2026-28) x MRVL capture; capture rises from 0.75% to ~0.97% on the custom ramp the CEO described (custom more than doubles in FY2028) and flattens in FY2029 for ASIC competition. That gives FY2028 $19.2B and EPS ~$7.28, 2-4% under consensus and the outlook (moderately conservative base). Year 3 (FY2029) margin ~41% non-GAAP is above MRVL's FY2026 35%, an upcycle level; the horizon multiple (19.2x, from the k=0.8 shrink of a 23.7x peer median at current closes toward MRVL's 18.2x) partly prices that. Deal: valued LITE on consensus FY Jun-2028 EPS at 17x with $1B synergies phased in; on those inputs MRVL holders give up ~$8/share if it closes, x 0.65 probability, plus a 12% chance of the $3.2B regulatory fee: about -$5.8/share. Not driver-linked: both merger adjustments. Scenarios: downside (P10, $71) puts capex on the file's low case, cuts capture and GM and the multiple to ~15x; upside (P90, $303) uses the high case, capture at the company's outlook and the snapshot peer multiple. The spread (ln 166.7/71 = 0.85; ln 303/166.7 = 0.60) is wider on the left, consistent with 86% realized vol and the stock's 56% drawdown. Research used primary documents mainly (releases, 8-Ks, 10-Q facts, call transcript, investor-day recap); consensus from Yahoo (2026-11-23) and StockAnalysis (2026-11-20).

inputs_detail.derivation: Actual quarters = filed DC revenue / ai_capex (0.0106 Q1 FY26 falling to 0.0074 Q1 FY27 as the 2025 Trainium transition rolled off, 0.0075 Q2 FY27). Forecast rises to 0.0088 in Q4 FY27 and 0.0095 by Q4 FY28 because (a) CEO Murphy (Q2 FY27 call, source 8): custom 'expected to ramp significantly in the second half' and 'will more than double year-over-year in fiscal 2028'; (b) Google custom agreement with a warrant vesting per $500M of Google custom revenue from Q3 FY27 (8-K, source 12); (c) scale-up optics ~$300M category incl. Celestial ~$150M for next year (Murphy, source 8). FY29 capture flattens at 0.0096-0.00975: ASIC competition (Broadcom, MediaTek) and customer capex growth slowing to +22% in CY2028 (source 21). Other evidence-based builds: (1) consensus FY28 revenue $19.71B (source 16) implies FY28 capture ~0.0099; (2) company FY28 outlook ~$20B (investor day, source 13) implies ~0.0101; (3) file low/high capex at this capture (scenarios). model_inputs.structure_note: Semis playbook, fabless: quarterly driver build (customer AI capex x MRVL capture for data center; comms & other y/y; non-GAAP gross margin; non-GAAP opex) for FY2027-FY2029, valued on two horizon legs: NTM P/E 19.2x (60%) and NTM levered FCF yield 4.5% (40%, tech FCF-leg rule). EBIT is non-GAAP (ex SBC, acquired-intangible amortization) with SBC carried as share dilution net of buybacks (+0.5% a year). No DCF (not a neocloud). No SOTP: DC is ~88% of revenue and comms too small to change the value. The pending Lumentum merger (close H1 CY2028, after the horizon) enters as two equity adjustments, not driver-linked. Interest and other income are their own quarter lines (rule 29).
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) Lumentum transfer (-5.0B; LITE multiple 17x and P(close) 0.65 are judgment; range -1.7B to +3.7B). (2) dc_capture path below the company FY28 outlook (+5% if at outlook). (3) peer P/E measured at 2026-11-20 closes rather than the table snapshot (table median would add ~20%). Driver set was not pre-approved by a card (forecaster lane; the supervisor carries it). Financing: no equity raise expected; the deal itself issues ~454M shares at close, after the horizon, so it is in the adjustment, not financing_events. Google warrant (58.97M at $206.58) is out of the money in base and downside; in the upside it dilutes ~1-2% (not modelled). FY2029 is a 53-week year (ends 2029-02-03).
